svg.title: Before Help Arrives
svg.desc: A wordless first-aid poster of six cards. Each card shows an emergency on top and, below the arrow, what anyone can do about it. Navy is the person in trouble, red the danger, green is you.

g.aria-label: Someone collapses and is not breathing: call for help, then push hard on the centre of the chest, 5 to 6 cm deep, 100 to 120 times a minute.
g.title: Someone collapses and is not breathing: call for help, then push hard on the centre of the chest, 5 to 6 cm deep, 100 to 120 times a minute.

g.aria-label: Someone is choking and cannot breathe or speak: give 5 hard blows between the shoulder blades, then 5 inward-and-upward thrusts above the navel, and repeat.
g.title: Someone is choking and cannot breathe or speak: give 5 hard blows between the shoulder blades, then 5 inward-and-upward thrusts above the navel, and repeat.

g.aria-label: Heavy bleeding: press a clean cloth firmly on the wound and keep pressing without letting go, for ten minutes or more, and call for help.
g.title: Heavy bleeding: press a clean cloth firmly on the wound and keep pressing without letting go, for ten minutes or more, and call for help.

g.aria-label: Signs of a stroke: one side of the face droops, one arm cannot stay raised, speech is slurred or confused. Call an ambulance immediately; every minute counts.
g.title: Signs of a stroke: one side of the face droops, one arm cannot stay raised, speech is slurred or confused. Call an ambulance immediately; every minute counts.

g.aria-label: Diarrhoea drains the body of water and kills by dehydration: stir 6 level teaspoons of sugar and half a level teaspoon of salt into 1 litre of clean water, and give it in frequent small sips.
g.title: Diarrhoea drains the body of water and kills by dehydration: stir 6 level teaspoons of sugar and half a level teaspoon of salt into 1 litre of clean water, and give it in frequent small sips.

g.aria-label: A burn: hold it under cool running water for 20 minutes, as soon as possible.
g.title: A burn: hold it under cool running water for 20 minutes, as soon as possible.
